company.name: Sai Pooja Fabrication
company.shortDescription: Specialists in durable agricultural machinery, tractor-mounted implements, and precision structural fabrication built for demanding field conditions.
company.longDescription: Sai Pooja Fabrication manufactures high-strength agricultural implements and custom equipment designed around practical farming needs. By combining heavy structural steel channels, wear-resistant boron points, and precision MIG welding, we produce implements that withstand tough soil conditions, heavy draft loads, and years of demanding fieldwork.
company.philosophy: We believe agricultural machinery should be built with the structural resilience of industrial equipment. Every frame, hinge pin, and turnover mechanism is calibrated for maximum field turnaround and minimal downtime.

faqs.question: What agricultural equipment does Sai Pooja Fabrication manufacture?
faqs.answer: We manufacture a wide range of tractor-mounted agricultural implements including Hydraulic Reversible Ploughs, Rigid Tine Cultivators, Heavy-Duty Rotavators, Seed Cum Fertilizer Drills, Disc Harrows, Furrow Ridgers, Land Levelers, and Hydraulic Tipping Farm Trailers.

faqs.question: Can you fabricate custom implements for non-standard tractor hitches or specific crop spacing?
faqs.answer: Yes. We specialize in custom heavy agricultural fabrication. We can engineer custom toolbars, modify 3-point hitch geometry (CAT-I, CAT-II), and build specialized sugarcane or horticulture furrowing attachments according to your tractor and field dimensions.

faqs.question: How do I determine the right implement size for my tractor horsepower?
faqs.answer: Each implement category is engineered for specific tractor power ranges (e.g. 35-50 HP for 9-tine cultivators, 45-75+ HP for 2/3 bottom reversible ploughs). You can check the specifications on each product page or send us your tractor model and horsepower for direct factory recommendations.

faqs.question: How can I inquire about prices and delivery timelines?
faqs.answer: You can submit an inquiry through our website form, connect directly on WhatsApp (+91 98765 43210), or call our workshop directly. We provide transparent factory pricing and dispatch timelines based on your location.

faqs.question: Can I visit your fabrication workshop to inspect equipment before ordering?
faqs.answer: Yes, visitors and farmers are welcome to visit our fabrication workshop during operating hours (Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM). Please contact us in advance to ensure the specific implement model is ready for inspection.
